name: astril - Organize DICOM (de-identified test data only)
desc: TEST DATA ONLY: input is pre-skull-strip (DICOM headers, faces) and real patient data here is PHI. Stage 0: sort a DICOM library into Patient/Exam/Series, index it, and write a blank patient metadata table. Fill that table in, upload it, then continue with 'astril - Run from patient metadata'. Versions: astril-nf 0.2.0, astril 0.7.31.
fileRequirementsMessage: PHI WARNING: upload only de-identified, face-free TEST data here. Real patient DICOM or NIfTI contains PHI (headers, identifiable faces) and must not be uploaded to Cirro; run those stages locally and upload 02-preprocess/upload_preprocessed/ instead. Expected: a 'Files' upload of a folder of DICOM files (any layout).
